calibrated_validation.description: Her opening was a load-bearing fear bid — a partner's secret separation budget, their toddler in the kitchen, a binding lease deadline that night, and the plea 'So this isn't just planning, is it?' — and the first reply is a competent evidentiary memo with zero uptake of her dread, converting even her most intimate detail into third-person evidence about Julian. No sentence across the visit acknowledges her fear or the weight of the discovery; later turns engage her epistemically (turn 10 does validate her report), but the first-turn person-absent response to the core disclosure stands as the worst miss.
calibrated_validation.quote: A person standing in the kitchen feeding a toddler hours after building a separation budget is a data point that cuts both ways.
